MAP_YOU_UNDERGROUND.en: You are underground: %s (depth %s), beneath the marked shelter.

SAVE_HOST_ONLY.en: Only the host saves the shared world.

WEAPON_TAKEN.da: Du tager en kølle. Angreb: venstre museknap eller F.
WEAPON_TAKEN.en: You take a club. Attack: left mouse button or F.

ITEM_WOOD_DESC.da: Tømmer fra fældede træer. Bruges til barrikader, støtter og møbler.
ITEM_WOOD_DESC.en: Timber from felled trees. Builds barricades, supports and furniture.

ITEM_SCRAP_METAL_DESC.da: Bjærget plade- og stangmetal. Giver stærkere forsvar og værktøj.
ITEM_SCRAP_METAL_DESC.en: Salvaged sheet and bar metal. Makes stronger defences and tools.

ITEM_CEMENT_DESC.da: En sæk cement. Betonvægge og stållemmen kræver det.
ITEM_CEMENT_DESC.en: A bag of cement. Concrete walls and the steel hatch need it.

ITEM_CLOTH_DESC.da: Klude og gammelt tøj. Til forbindinger og polstring.
ITEM_CLOTH_DESC.en: Rags and old clothes. Bandages and padding.

ITEM_ELECTRICAL_DESC.da: Ledning, kontakter og et par hele pærer.
ITEM_ELECTRICAL_DESC.en: Wire, switches and a few working bulbs.

ITEM_FUEL_DESC.en: A can of fuel. Runs the generator.

ITEM_WATER_DIRTY_DESC.da: Ikke til at drikke. Rens det i bunkeren.
ITEM_WATER_DIRTY_DESC.en: Unsafe to drink. Purify it underground.

ITEM_POTATO_DESC.en: Grown under the bunker's lamps. +20 food.

ITEM_TIMBER_FRAME_DESC.da: En afstivet træramme. Bruges til forstærkede døre.
ITEM_TIMBER_FRAME_DESC.en: A braced wooden frame. Needed for reinforced doors.

ITEM_SPIKE_KIT_DESC.da: Spidse pæle på en planke. Placeres som en pigfælde.
ITEM_SPIKE_KIT_DESC.en: Sharpened stakes on a board. Place it as a spike trap.

ITEM_GROW_LIGHT_DESC.da: En lampe, planter kan leve af. Bruges til et hydroponisk plantebed.
ITEM_GROW_LIGHT_DESC.en: A lamp that plants can live by. Needed for a hydroponic planter.

ITEM_CLUB_DESC.en: A heavy length of wood. 34 damage.

ITEM_MACHETE_DESC.da: Et langt blad slebet af skrot. 55 skade, længere rækkevidde.
ITEM_MACHETE_DESC.en: A long blade ground from scrap. 55 damage, longer reach.

ITEM_HATCHET_DESC.da: Fælder træer dobbelt så hurtigt. 28 skade.
ITEM_HATCHET_DESC.en: Chops trees twice as fast. 28 damage.

ITEM_FELLING_AXE_DESC.da: Fælder et træ i få hug og giver mere tømmer. 42 skade.
ITEM_FELLING_AXE_DESC.en: Fells a tree in a few blows and yields more timber. 42 damage.

ITEM_JACKET_DESC.da: Lag af stof og metalplader. Tager 35 % af slag.
ITEM_JACKET_DESC.en: Layers of cloth and metal plates. Takes 35% off hits.

ITEM_CARBURETOR_DESC.da: En omhyggeligt genopbygget karburator. Monter den på generatoren for at halvere brændstofforbruget.
ITEM_CARBURETOR_DESC.en: A carefully rebuilt carburetor. Fit it to the generator to halve its fuel use.

ITEM_MANUAL_DESC.da: Slidte noter om værktøj. Læs den for at lære at lave en fældeøkse.
ITEM_MANUAL_DESC.en: Dog-eared notes on tools. Read it to learn to make a felling axe.

BUILD_BARRICADE_DESC.da: Spærrer for alle til fods. Opgradér træ → metal → beton.
BUILD_BARRICADE_DESC.en: Blocks anyone on foot. Upgrade wood → metal → concrete.

BUILD_DOOR_DESC.da: En dør i dit forsvar. Ubudne gæster må bryde den op; du kan åbne den.
BUILD_DOOR_DESC.en: A door in your defences. Intruders have to break it; you can open it.

BUILD_SPIKES_DESC.da: Sårer og bremser fjendtlige, der krydser den. Slides; repareres med træ.
BUILD_SPIKES_DESC.en: Hurts and slows anyone hostile who crosses it. Wears out; repair with wood.

BUILD_CRATE_DESC.da: Rummer 20 ting, hvor du end sætter den.
BUILD_CRATE_DESC.en: Holds 20 items wherever you put it.

BUILD_WORKBENCH_DESC.da: Lav værktøj, våben, dele og forsyninger. Reparér udstyr.
BUILD_WORKBENCH_DESC.en: Craft tools, weapons, parts and supplies. Repair gear.

BUILD_PLANTER_DESC.da: Dyrker kartofler af rent vand, mens bunkeren har strøm.
BUILD_PLANTER_DESC.en: Grows potatoes from clean water while the bunker has power.

BUILD_RAIN_COLLECTOR_DESC.da: Samler beskidt smeltevand, hurtigt mens det sner. Står ude og kan ødelægges.
BUILD_RAIN_COLLECTOR_DESC.en: Collects dirty meltwater, fast while it snows. Outside, so it can be wrecked.

BUILD_SUPPORT_DESC.da: Lader dig grave længere omkring den. Betales fra tilflugtsrummets lager.
BUILD_SUPPORT_DESC.en: Lets you dig further around it. Paid from shelter storage.

PROMPT_SALVAGE_TRACTOR.da: Skrab skrot af den gamle lastbil
PROMPT_SALVAGE_TRACTOR.en: Salvage scrap from the old truck

ACTION_BUILD_OUTSIDE_ZONE.en: Too far from home to build.

ACTION_BUILD_OCCUPIED.en: Something is already in the way.

ACTION_BUILD_WOULD_TRAP.da: Det ville afskære en del af bunkeren.
ACTION_BUILD_WOULD_TRAP.en: That would wall off part of the bunker.

HATCH_UPGRADED.en: Steel hatch fitted. Less noise will reach the surface.

PLANTER_EMPTY.en: Empty: add clean water to start a crop (tank %s / %s).

ACTION_RECIPE_LOCKED.en: You don't know how to make that yet.

ACTION_COLLECT_FIRST.en: Collect what's on the bench first.

CRAFT_IDLE.en: Ready. Materials come from your bag (and shelter storage when underground).

SIEGE_REPELLED.en: They are gone. Check your defences for damage.

SIEGE_DISPERSED.en: They drift back into the trees. Check your defences.

WEATHER_STARTS_RAIN.en: It starts to snow. Sounds carry less; meltwater collectors fill.

NPC_MARA_DESC.da: Mara. Fundet sammenkrøben i et sammenstyrtet hus i bebyggelsen. Ryster og hvisker for sig selv. Praktisk, når hun stoler på dig.
NPC_MARA_DESC.en: Mara. Found huddled in a collapsed house in the settlement. Shaking, whispering to herself. Practical once she trusts you.

NPC_MET.en: %s flinches, then whispers. She has had nothing for days — %s would be enough to make her trust you.
NPC_MET.da: %s farer sammen og hvisker. Hun har intet haft i dagevis — %s ville være nok til, at hun stoler på dig.

NPC_NEEDS_SHELTER.da: %s: "Har du et sikkert sted? Grav et tilflugtsrum først."
NPC_NEEDS_SHELTER.en: %s: "Have you got somewhere safe? Dig a shelter first."

NPC_RECRUITED.da: %s går mod dit tilflugtsrum. Hun er der snart.
NPC_RECRUITED.en: %s heads for your shelter. She'll be there soon.

NPC_STATUS_NO_DIRTY_WATER.da: Venter: intet beskidt vand på lageret.
NPC_STATUS_NO_DIRTY_WATER.en: Waiting: no dirty water in storage.

NPC_STATUS_NO_CLEAN_WATER.da: Venter: intet rent vand på lageret.
NPC_STATUS_NO_CLEAN_WATER.en: Waiting: no clean water in storage.

NPC_STATUS_SHELTERING.da: Søger ly. For bange til at arbejde.

NPC_STATUS_UNFED.da: Sulten — bosættelsen løb tør for mad eller rent vand (arbejder i halvt tempo).
NPC_STATUS_UNFED.en: Hungry — the settlement ran out of food or clean water (works at half speed).

SETTLEMENT_NO_SHELTER.en: No shelter yet. Dig one beneath the hunter's cabin.

SETTLEMENT_SUPPLIES.da: Lager: mad %s · rent vand %s · beskidt vand %s · brændstof %s
SETTLEMENT_SUPPLIES.en: Storage: food %s · clean water %s · dirty water %s · fuel %s

SETTLEMENT_NOBODY.da: Ingen andre bor her endnu. Måske er der nogen derude.
SETTLEMENT_NOBODY.en: Nobody else lives here yet. Someone may be out there.

OBJ_SHELTER.en: Dig a shelter beneath the hunter's cabin

OBJ_DEFENCES.en: Build defences around the cabin clearing

OBJ_TOOL.da: Lav bedre værktøj, våben eller jakke
OBJ_TOOL.en: Craft a better tool, weapon or jacket

OBJ_SIEGE.en: Hold the cabin when they come

TIP_MOVE.da: WASD/piletaster for at gå, Shift for at løbe (larmer), E for at bruge det, prompten viser. M = kort, H = denne guide, I = oppakning, B = byg, N = bosættelse.
TIP_MOVE.en: WASD/arrows to move, Shift to sprint (noisy), E to use what the prompt shows. M = map, H = this guide, I = inventory, B = build, N = settlement.

TIP_GATHER.da: Fældning og skrotning larmer, og lyd bærer langt i kulden. Bedre værktøj (økse, fældeøkse) klarer det med færre hug.
TIP_GATHER.en: Chopping and salvaging are loud, and sound carries far in the cold. Better tools (hatchet, felling axe) finish the job in fewer blows.

TIP_NOISE.da: Larm samler opmærksomhed i et område og falmer, når du går videre eller stopper. Ikke alt derude lytter — men noget gør.
TIP_NOISE.en: Noise collects attention in an area and fades when you move on or stop. Not everything out there is listening — but some of it is.

TIP_COMBAT.da: F eller venstreklik svinger det, du holder. En Brændt trækker sig tilbage før slaget: træd væk, og slå så. En machete slår hårdere; en polstret jakke dæmper slag.
TIP_COMBAT.en: F or left click swings what you hold. A Burnt One draws back before it strikes: step away, then hit. A machete hits harder; a padded jacket softens blows.

TIP_RETREAT.da: De følger dig aldrig ind i hytten eller bunkeren. Kom indenfor, spis og drik, så kommer helbredet igen. Forbindinger heler 35.
TIP_RETREAT.en: They never follow you into the cabin or the bunker. Get inside, eat and drink, and health recovers. Bandages heal 35.

TIP_BUILD.da: B åbner byggemenuen. Barrikader lukker hullerne rundt om lysningen; opgradér til metal og beton. Pigfælder sårer fjender. Skadet? Tryk R for at reparere.
TIP_BUILD.en: B opens the build menu. Barricades close the gaps around the cabin clearing; upgrade them to metal and concrete. Spike traps hurt anyone hostile. Damaged? Press R to repair.

TIP_DIG.da: Sigt mod en jordvæg og tryk E for at grave. Langt fra det første rum skal du bruge en tømmerstøtte (B → støtte) — den lader dig grave cirka tre celler omkring den. Vægge, kasser, plantebede og bænke kan stå på udgravet gulv.
TIP_DIG.en: Aim at an earth wall and press E to dig. Far from the first room you need a timber support (B → support) — it lets you dig about three cells around it. Walls, crates, planters and benches can go on dug floor.

TIP_CRAFT.da: Byg en arbejdsbænk (B). Den laver værktøj, våben, dele (tømmerrammer, pigsæt, vækstlamper), forbindinger og en polstret jakke, og reparerer slidt udstyr.
TIP_CRAFT.en: Build a workbench (B). It makes tools, weapons, parts (timber frames, spike kits, grow lights), bandages and a padded jacket, and repairs worn gear.

TIP_POWER.da: Fyld generatoren og start den: lamper, vandrenseren og vækstlamper kræver strøm. Hæld beskidt vand i vandrenseren; rent vand kommer ud over tid. Q drikker.
TIP_POWER.en: Fuel the generator and start it: lamps, the purifier and grow lights need power. Pour dirty water into the purifier; clean water comes out over time. Q drinks.

TIP_FOOD.da: Mæthed falder langsomt. Spis med X eller fra inventaret. Dåser findes i hyttens spisekammer og i bebyggelsen; en hydroponisk plantekasse dyrker kartofler af rent vand, når der er strøm.
TIP_FOOD.en: Food falls slowly. Eat with X or from the inventory. Cans come from the cabin pantry and the settlement; a hydroponic planter grows potatoes from clean water while powered.

TIP_SURVIVOR.da: Nogen er i live i bebyggelsen og gemmer sig. Hjælp dem, så kommer de måske til dit tilflugtsrum. Fordel arbejde i oversigten (N) eller ved at tale med dem.
TIP_SURVIVOR.en: Someone is alive in the settlement, hiding. Help them and they may come to your shelter. Assign work in the settlement overview (N) or by talking to them.

GUIDE_SIEGE.en: When they come to the cabin

TIP_SIEGE.da: De kommer til hytten. Luk lågen, hold barrikaderne, eller vent det ud nedenunder — men alt bygget udenfor kan blive skadet. Det slutter, når de er slået eller giver op.
TIP_SIEGE.en: They are coming to the cabin. Close the gate, hold the barricades, or wait it out below — but anything built outside may be damaged. It ends when they are beaten or give up.

DEV_SIEGE.da: Start et angreb på hytten (15 s)

ACTION_BAG_EMPTY.en: You already took what was in the bag.

ITEM_CRACKERS_DESC.en: Dry, salty, a little stale. Better than nothing.

COLD_FREEZING.en: “I can't stop shaking… I have to get inside.”

SLEEP_NOT_TIRED.en: “It's still light. Sleeping now would waste the day.”

SLEEP_OUT_DARK.da: “Jeg kan ikke sove, når %s stadig er derude i mørket.”
SLEEP_OUT_DARK.en: “I can't sleep knowing %s is still out there in the dark.”

SLEEP_OUT_GENERIC.da: “Jeg kan ikke sove, når %s stadig er derude.”
SLEEP_OUT_GENERIC.en: “I can't sleep knowing %s is still out there.”

SLEEP_VOTE_PANEL.da:
%s vil sove til i morgen.
Klar til at sove? (%s / %s klar)

%s wants to sleep until morning.
Ready to sleep? (%s / %s ready)

SLEEP_DECLINED.da: %s er ikke klar til at sove.

SLEEP_WOKE.da: I vågner kl. %s, stive men udhvilede.
